source: Figure 4 of 'Circuits of LLM Classifiers' (arXiv 2610.30076), recovered from the vector drawing of img/frontiers.pdf by scripts/extract_frontier.py
note: Values are read off the figure, not taken from the evaluation reports. cost: expected cost per item, rescaled by the priciest judge's mean call (4 significant figures); acc, lo, hi: accuracy in % and its 95% interval (0.01). Curves list the vertices matplotlib drew, so collinear points dropped by path simplification are missing; points at the axis' left edge (cost 0.003) stand for budgets costing at most that. lo/hi are given only where the figure draws a bar (five per LMCircuit curve, three per baseline), null elsewhere; a bar's lower end is clipped at the point (as drawn). A point marked approx has no line drawn (all of that curve's points coincide) and takes its accuracy from the midpoint of its bar. models: the pool judges (large diamonds), named by the calls legend; other_judges: judges outside the pool (small grey diamonds, unnamed in the figure; one may sit just past an axis, drawn clipped). calls: the circuit's calls per item to each pool judge, stacked cheapest first, bands resampled on a shared cost grid (0.001 calls). x_range / y_range are the axes' limits.
